messages:
customer-jane: Hey @support — suddenly seeing a bunch of 400s from functions.invoke in prod. Started after we upgraded the SDK to 1.8.1. Repro below, can someone take a look?

support-bot: Thanks — incident created INC-789. Please paste the failing request + response.

customer-jane: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/functions/invoke 

```
{
  "session_id": "sess-9abc",
  "function": "billing.generateInvoice",
  "customer": null,
  "items": { "sku-123": { "qty": 1, "amount": "1000" } },
  "metadata": null,
  "debug": true
}
```

Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "JsonSchemaValidationError",
  "message": "Additional properties are not allowed ('metadata' was unexpected)",
  "details": [
    { "path": "/", "error": "additionalProperties", "unexpected": ["metadata"] },
    { "path": "/items", "error": "type", "expected": "array", "found": "object" },
    { "path": "/items/sku-123/amount", "error": "type", "expected": "number", "found": "string" },
    { "path": "/customer", "error": "required", "missing": ["customer_id"] }
  ]
}
```

jon: Thanks for the clear repro. Two things jumping out: 1) our strict validator for the billing function does not permit top-level unknown keys (so `metadata` triggers additionalProperties). 2) `items` should be an array and amounts must be numbers — the SDK change apparently started serializing items as an object map and stringifying amounts.

maria: @jon do we have a quick mitigation? This is breaking multiple customers after 1.8.1 rollout.

jon: I'm patching the gateway to run a compatibility shim that strips known-unsafe top-level keys (metadata, debug) and coerces numeric strings inside items where safe. Patch will be pushed to canary in ~15m. Note: this is a stopgap — long term we should tighten SDK tests.

ryan: FYI the validator step adds ~180ms median to the call path on canary because of the extra coercion. Observability/infra flagged that as acceptable for now; will watch.

support-bot: Patch deployed to canary (gw-compat-shim v0.1.3). Can you retest against canary endpoint or I can roll it to prod if you confirm? :thumbsup:

customer-jane: Retested on canary — functions.invoke succeeded and returned 202 + invoice_id. Thanks. Can you share recommended client-side fix?

jon: Short-term: modify payloads before upgrade: items must be an array of { sku, qty, amount } and amount must be a number; remove top-level debug/metadata keys. Better: upgrade to SDK 1.8.2 (we rebuilt the serializer to preserve arrays and numeric types and added tests).

maria: Created follow-up ticket ENG-1452 to add contract tests across SDK+gateway+validator. Also rolling a notification to customers who upgraded to 1.8.1.

ryan: Rolling the shim to prod in 30m after monitoring. Also adding a lightweight validation metric so we can alert on schema rejections in real time.

customer-jane: Appreciate the fast turnaround. One ask: can you include the exact curl shape we should send?

jon: Yes — minimal working shape:
```
{
  "session_id": "sess-9abc",
  "function": "billing.generateInvoice",
  "customer_id": "cus_789",
  "items": [ { "sku": "sku-123", "qty": 1, "amount": 1000 } ]
}
```

customer-jane: Got it, switching back to that shape. Will keep an eye and upgrade to 1.8.2 tomorrow. Thanks all :heart:

support-bot: INC-789 -> resolved (workaround + SDK patch). Closing after post-deploy check in 24h.
